Dear Ms Adeyemi,

Your advert for a Finance Business Partner at Harrow & Pike asks for someone who can make month-end faster without losing control of it. That is the work I have done at Northgate Foods for the last two years.

When I joined Northgate in March 2022, close took 9 working days and most of that was manual bank reconciliation. I rebuilt 14 reconciliations in Power Query and moved the close to 5 days by October 2023. It took longer than planned. The first version broke every time a bank changed its statement layout, so I added a check that flags a format change before it reaches the ledger.

Your team supports six regional sites, and I run a similar rhythm now. Each month I sit down with 6 site general managers and go through their variances line by line. We leave with an action and a named owner for anything over budget. Two of those managers had never used a variance pack before 2023, so I rebuilt it around the two numbers they already watch every shift, cases shipped and overtime hours. Some months that is two actions; in January it was eleven.

I also built the rolling 18-month EBITDA forecast that the board uses, and FY2024 landed within 2% of actual. I'd like to bring that kind of forecasting to the Harrow & Pike food-service division, where your annual report says margins moved more than anywhere else in the group.

I am free for a call any afternoon from Monday 9 November, and I can start with one month's notice.

Yours sincerely,
Hannah Okafor
